class.name: YAMLResult
class.brief_description: Contains the results or errors from YAML operations.
class.description: Contains the results from YAML parsing or emitting operations, providing a unified interface for both successful data and error cases. This class serves as a return type for API methods, containing either the parsed/emitted data or error information. [YAMLResult] objects are immutable and can contain either successful data or error information, but not both. When an operation succeeds, the result contains the data and no error. When an operation fails, the result contains error information and empty data. Multi-document YAML is fully supported, allowing you to access each document individually through [method get_document] or [method get_data] with an index parameter.

method.name: error
method.description: Creates an error result with the specified error message and optional line and column information. [codeblocks] [gdscript] # Create an error result var result = YAMLResult.error("Invalid YAML syntax", 5, 10) print(result.has_error()) # Output: true print(result.get_error_message()) # Output: Invalid YAML syntax print(result.get_error_line()) # Output: 5 print(result.get_error_column()) # Output: 10 [/gdscript] [/codeblocks]

method.name: get_data
method.description:
Returns the result data. For multi-document YAML, specify an index to access a specific document. Returns [code]null[/code] for error results or if the index is out of range. For single-document results, [code]index[/code] parameter can be omitted. [codeblocks] [gdscript] # Parse a multi-document YAML string var yaml_string = """ # First document title: Document 1 --- # Second document title: Document 2 """
var result = YAML.parse(yaml_string) if !result.has_error(): var first_doc = result.get_data(0) # Access first document var second_doc = result.get_data(1) # Access second document
print(first_doc.title) # Output: Document 1 print(second_doc.title) # Output: Document 2 [/gdscript] [/codeblocks]

method.name: get_document
get_document_count
method.description:
Returns the number of documents in the result. Returns [code]0[/code] for error cases, [code]1[/code] for single document results, and the document count for multi-document results. [codeblocks] [gdscript] # Parse a multi-document YAML string var yaml_string = """ # First document title: Document 1 --- # Second document title: Document 2 --- # Third document title: Document 3 """
var result = YAML.parse(yaml_string) if !result.has_error(): var count = result.get_document_count() print("Number of documents: %d" % count) # Output: Number of documents: 3
for i in range(count): var doc = result.get_document(i) print("Document %d: %s" % [i, doc.title]) [/gdscript] [/codeblocks]

method.name: get_error_column
method.description:
Returns the error column number if any. Returns [code]-1[/code] if not applicable or if there is no error. [codeblocks] [gdscript] var yaml_string = "key: value\ninvalid field" var result = YAML.validate(yaml_string)
if result.has_error(): print("Error at line %d, column %d: %s" % [ result.get_error_line(), result.get_error_column(), result.get_error_message() ]) [/gdscript] [/codeblocks]

method.name: get_error_line
method.description:
Returns the error line number if any. Returns [code]-1[/code] if not applicable or if there is no error. [codeblocks] [gdscript] var yaml_string = "player:\n name: Hero\n level: invalid" var result = YAML.parse(yaml_string)
if result.has_error(): print("Error at line %d: %s" % [ result.get_error_line(), result.get_error_message() ]) [/gdscript] [/codeblocks]

method.name: get_error_message
method.description:
Returns the error message if any. Returns an empty string if there is no error. [codeblocks] [gdscript] var yaml_string = "invalid: [yaml: syntax" var result = YAML.validate(yaml_string)
if result.has_error(): print("YAML error: " + result.get_error_message()) else: print("YAML is valid") [/gdscript] [/codeblocks]

method.name: get_style
method.description:
Returns the style information if any. Returns [code]null[/code] if no style information is available. Style information is only available if style detection was enabled during parsing using the [code]detect_style[/code] parameter of [method YAML.parse]. [codeblocks] [gdscript] # Parse with style detection enabled var yaml_string = """ list: - item1 - item2 nested: {key1: value1, key2: value2} # Flow style multiline: | # Literal style This is a multiline string that preserves line breaks """
var result = YAML.parse(yaml_string, true) # Enable style detection if !result.has_error() && result.has_style(): var data = result.get_data() var style = result.get_style()
# Modify data while preserving style data.list.append("item3")
# Re-emit with preserved style var output = YAML.stringify(data, style).get_data() print(output) [/gdscript] [/codeblocks]

method.name: has_error
has_style
method.description:
Returns [code]true[/code] if the result contains style information. Style information is only available if style detection was enabled during parsing using the [code]detect_style[/code] parameter of [method YAML.parse]. [codeblocks] [gdscript] var yaml_string = """ regular: value flow_style: {a: 1, b: 2} block_scalar: | This is a multiline string with preserved newlines """
# Parse with style detection enabled var result = YAML.parse(yaml_string, true)
if !result.has_error(): print("Has style information: " + str(result.has_style())) # Output: Has style information: true
if result.has_style(): var style = result.get_style() # Use style for emitting var output = YAML.stringify(result.get_data(), style) [/gdscript] [/codeblocks]

method.name: success
